notes:
- Windows 发行版移除进程密钥提取和媒体密钥自动推导。已有归档可离线查看和搜索；增量同步需要有效的已保存凭据。新账号首次同步、V2 图片及加密表情预览暂不可用。
- The Windows release removes process key extraction and automatic media key derivation. Existing archives remain browsable and searchable offline. Incremental sync requires valid saved credentials. First-time sync, V2 image previews and encrypted sticker previews are unavailable.
- 在「设置 → 智能体服务」中为每个服务选择新会话默认模型。独立 AI 对话与微信侧栏都会采用该选择，已有会话保留自己的模型和思考强度。
- Choose a default model per provider in Settings → Agent services. New standalone and sidebar chats use that choice. Existing chats keep their own model and reasoning effort.
- 在同一会话切换模型或思考强度时保留读取权限、自定义日期范围和剩余额度。Codex 自动检测优先选择较新的本机运行时，已在 Windows 实测列出 GPT‑6.2 Sol 和 Astra。
- Switching models or reasoning effort in a chat preserves its archive permissions, date range and remaining read budget. On Windows, automatic Codex discovery selected the newer local runtime and returned GPT‑6.2 Sol and Astra.
- 适配 DeepSeek Harness 新版账号插件。Windows 桌面运行时 0.2.2-rc.3 与 CLI 0.2.2-rc.5 通过本地模拟服务的流式回复、工具调用及历史恢复测试。真实账号成功读取模型目录，在线回复测试遇到账户额度限制，界面现会提示额度不足。
- Support the updated DeepSeek Harness account plugin. Windows desktop runtime 0.2.2-rc.3 and CLI 0.2.2-rc.5 passed streaming, tool and history tests against a local test server. A live account returned its model catalog. Its online reply hit the account quota limit, which the app now reports.
